text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"...Judging by her last race, I think it's safe to say
we can expect big things from Nakayama Festa, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Just being 'decently skilled' isn't gonna cut it.
If she's publicly declaring the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe as her goal,
she needs to win this easily~.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Well, you can't really make that call just yet.
We'll have to wait and see first.
Whether she... will get buried in the Classics or not.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha.
Same old judging session, as always."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, the closer you push me to the edge,
the happier my heart's gonna be, though.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer.
Did you gather any useful information?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Have you prepared criteria by which
you can judge today's run?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll be sure to watch closely.
Yeah, I'll be watching you very closely.

text_block_list.text:
We're probably the only ones using this Keisei Hai
as a testing ground for taking on the world.

"That's why I spent over half a year researching the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
I also sorted through all the information on Nakayama Festa."

At present, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
has a fierce headwind blowing
against Japanese Umamusume.

Should Nakayama Festa face that wind head-on right now?
Or should she wait until she has honed her skills further?
choice_data_list: I'll time it right to bring out your absolute best.
I'll time it perfectly to bring out your full potential.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, guess it's time to head out.
――To our very first crossroads of destiny.

And Nakayama Festa headed
toward the paddock for the Keisei Hai—
